signal: Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR with 4,300+ customers and rolled out new PinPoint Data services on top of its location analytics platform.

email.body1:
Ryan, saw Placer.ai crossed $100M ARR with 4,300-plus customers and shipped your new PinPoint Data services.

Growth at that pace usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps get to them all, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Placer.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the new number
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

Past $100M ARR, the bar on net-new pipeline keeps climbing faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Placer.ai needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer.ai's reply rate likely compares to peers at your stage. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. At $100M ARR the team is clearly executing, and timing is everything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
